bibliography.used_for: USDA FPL2021 Chapters4/13 provide an actual wood-moisture programme: representative matched-state specimens, immediate weighing or moisture-protected storage, oven drying to constant mass and the stated dry-mass convention, plus electrical-meter calibration/species/temperature/depth/gradient limitations. Use u=(wet-dry)/dry and w=(wet-dry)/wet on actual compatible specimens, converting percentages to fractions; w=u/(1+u). The source warns that volatile extractives can make oven loss exceed true water. Do not equate whole coated/resin-containing/treated article loss with H2O or apply a timber meter to a complete house. Keep gypsum structural water, membrane/coating carriers, free/bound wood water and actual atmospheric sorption distinct. Whole supplied wet mass remains independently weighed even if a water subdivision is unresolved. An actually necessary untreated/treated-matrix or water-phase procedure not established remains a specific method hold; routine actual calibration/sampling/recovery of an established applicable programme is an unperformed study obligation. No climate EMC, density, moisture target, drying time, empirical range or source numerical performance becomes a PCR default. The retained handbook text is the procedure source here; its references to ASTM D4442/D4444 do not mean those complete standards were acquired or that ASTM conformity is claimed.

root_bounded_manual_review.actual_primary_context_review: Root read actual complete CLASSIC applicable specification/footnotes and alternatives, including4/6/10–20/22–26, plus historicalSHEQ49/55–57. Directly viewed actual CLASSIC13 and18 images to verify mineral-wool/timber-panel context and loose earthing clamp/site commissioning, rather than infer assembly completion from a catalogue name. Full specification confirms robust complete assembled steel-frame cabins as well as separate Transpack alternatives, P5/vinyl/coated-chipboard/mineral-wool options, finished fixed electrical installation and real downstream foundation/earthing/initial electrical checks. SHEQ real component fabrication, weldedframes, primer/powder, final completion by fitters/installers/electricians, finalQC and loading are substantive whole-manufacture evidence. Same publisher is not two independent factory observations. These support a transparent qualitative synthesis, not one contemporary SKU/factory, imported dimensions/mass/performance/certification/recipe or a commissioned occupied building. Actual permanent loose clamp and fastener stay in complete supply mass; real owned required completion cannot be paper-outsourced. Manufacturer English/German ambiguity remains conditional where actually material.
root_bounded_manual_review.native_and_classification_review: Whole2e810bc4 exact retained public100@01.01.000 is finished predominantly-metal manufactured building, productionmixatplant with trueMass/kg, not panel/skeleton/freight-container/erectionservice.23 full flows/all23FPUG and26bound rows per language independently matched to raw actual records and both-language official names/types/units. Historical observation times retained, no new onlinefreshness claim. Lumber/P5 nativeVolume has independent wet-mass/geometry collection bridge, no inferreddensity/area-buildingkg default. CN electricity and CN scrap are conditional actual matchinggeography only; European source is not CN measurement.83auxiliary/provider identities remain explicit.
root_bounded_manual_review.reused_method_context: Previously independently reviewed complete ILCD applicable allocation unit reused with original edition; not a blanket reread/visual-scan claim. Attributional allocation conditions and determining causality precede residual common-process value allocation.
root_bounded_manual_review.bilingual_and_accounting: Actual EN/ZH scopes, first-gate/mass/physical and inherited-history qualifications, nested whole contaminated receiver exports, per-original-cohort attributable service vectors and actual wet packaging equations reviewed with full typed/stored/source-context audits. Concrete unknown essentials remain holds; ordinary unperformed QA is not missing methodology.

38702.registration_note: Historical sources with no new common-store registration retain exact original/extraction hashes and prior applicable locators; no invented registration or numeric qualification.

bibliography.used_for: Primary commercial production of polyester blanks for buttons/accessories; supports a real separately supplied blank terminal. Does not identify the Jindal route, a common SKU or a transaction-specific acceptance limit.

bibliography.reference: Classic Buttons, Manufacturing process; https://classicbuttons.in/process-for-making-plastic-polyester-buttons-manufacturing-for-garments/
bibliography.used_for: Whole manufacturer page distinguishes sheet/blanking, downstream turning, polishing and final-button inspection; identifies candidate separate styrene/cobalt/wax roles. Those later finished-button operations are excluded, not transferred into blank Q.

bibliography.reference: US EPA AP-42 §4.4 Polyester Resin Plastic Products Fabrication, 02/2007 with 2008 table update; https://www.epa.gov/sites/default/files/2020-10/documents/c04s04.pdf
bibliography.used_for: Full primary PDF: supplied liquid resin versus upstream synthesis, crosslinking versus condensation, initiator and actual solvent/species questions. Figure4.4-1 and adjacent reinforced-process counterexamples limit use. No composite emission factor, monomer fraction or dose is adopted.

bibliography.reference: European Commission JRC, ILCD Handbook General guide for LCA, Detailed guidance, first edition March2010, §§7.9.2–7.9.3; https://eplca.jrc.ec.europa.eu/uploads/ILCD-Handbook-General-guide-for-LCA-DETAILED-GUIDANCE-12March2010-ISBN-fin-v1.0-EN.pdf
bibliography.used_for: Attributional subdivision/virtual subdivision, exchange-specific determining physical causality and genuinely residual actual-state common-gate market value. No free allocation choice or fixed ratios.

bibliography.reference: Samrat Poly Resins, Button Grade Resin; https://samratpolyresins.in/products/button-grade-resin/
bibliography.used_for: Primary example of liquid button-casting UPR supply, MEKP and cobalt-octoate cure roles. Specific advertised recipe, styrene fraction, cure timing, storage and drum quantities are not generalized or adopted. Does not establish a particular sheet route or common plant.

bibliography.used_for: Actual IR-active vapor programme, reference preparation, heated full transport, spectral/matrix validation/QA and source printed DF inconsistency; independent dimensional synthesis, no performed study or universal matrix coverage.
